Done. The fix is one prop in `app/page.tsx:15` — `prefetch={true}` on the category links.

**Why:** with `cacheComponents` enabled, a default Link prefetch uses `FetchStrategy.PPR` (static shell only), so the dynamic `CategoryResults` hole streams in after the click and flashes "Loading category...". `prefetch={true}` switches to `FetchStrategy.Full` (node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js:373), which prefetches the complete URL-specific RSC payload — resolved heading and products — into the client router cache when each link enters the viewport.

**Verified:**
- `next build` passes; `/catalog` stays a partial prerender, hrefs remain `/catalog?category=featured|sale`
- Full-prefetch requests for both URLs return the resolved content (`Products on sale`/`Canvas Tote`/`Travel Mug` and `Featured products`/`Desk Lamp`/`Wool Blanket`), so clicks render instantly from cache with no loading state and no fresh server render
